info.title: Wise Owl Inspector
info.description: Standalone metadata inspector for .NET assemblies — explore types, methods, fields, signatures, and IL bytecode. Interactive REPL plus one-shot mode; per-table drill-down, cross-table find, type and method scoped views, IL disassembly. Useful for diagnosing obfuscation results, comparing builds, or just reading bytecode without firing up a full decompiler. Free; no license required.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Wise Owl Inspector - interactive .NET assembly metadata browser.
Part of the Wise Owl .NET toolchain (https://www.wiseowlsoftware.com).
Use --mcp to start as an MCP server for AI-assisted inspection.

options.name: --table
options.description: Display specific metadata table(s). Repeatable. Names: typedef, methoddef, fielddef, paramdef, typeref, memberref, assemblyref, typespec, methodspec, interfaceimpl, customattr, property, event, constant, genericparam, nestedclass, resource, methodsemantics, methodimpl, standsig, propertymap, eventmap, moduleref, implmap, classlayout, fieldlayout, fieldrva, fieldmarshal, declsecurity, exportedtype, file.

options.name: --json
options.description: Output structured JSON for tooling. Forces one-shot mode.

options.name: --filter
options.description: Filter rows. Supports scoped queries like 'type=WeatherForecast', 'parent=OrderDto', 'sig=DateOnly', or unscoped substring match.

options.name: --type
options.description: Show a unified view of all types matching the given name pattern: fields, methods, properties, events, custom attributes, MethodImpls, and references. Composable with --il (appends IL for every method in the matched types + their compiler-generated nested types - closures, iterator/async state machines) and --method (narrows to matching names).

options.name: --method
options.description: Restrict method-level output (--il, --table methoddef) to methods whose name contains this substring, case-insensitive. ANDs with --type: '--type Foo --method Initialize' catches 'Foo::Initialize' and its synthesized '<Initialize>b__0' lambda.

options.name: --diff
options.description: Compare against another assembly. Pass the path of the second assembly. Output shows added/removed/changed types and members.

options.name: --query
options.description: Query assembly metadata using English. Examples: 'show methods returning string', 'which types implement IDisposable', 'how many fields'. Forces one-shot mode.

arguments.name: ASSEMBLY
arguments.description: Path to the .NET assembly to inspect.
